cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast from the BBC World Service.
cues.zh: 这里是 BBC World Service 的《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: Hello, I'm Ankur Desai, and in the early hours of Thursday, the 3rd of September, these are our main stories.
cues.zh: 你好，我是安库尔·德赛。9月3日星期四凌晨，以下是我们的主要新闻。

cues.en: Venezuela and the US hailed a new oil deal, which hands over a fifth of Venezuela's crude,
cues.zh: 委内瑞拉和美国称赞一项新的石油协议；协议将委内瑞拉五分之一的原油交由对方掌控，

cues.en: but critics say it's neocolonialism and likely to entrench the current authoritarian leadership.
cues.zh: 但批评者称这是新殖民主义，可能巩固现有的威权领导层。

cues.en: Protests across Spain in support of Ceuta, the Spanish territory that's seen a steep rise in migrants,
cues.zh: 西班牙各地举行示威，声援休达这个西班牙领土；那里接收的移民人数大幅上升，

cues.en: and New York's mayor, Zohran Mamdani, announces a one-year ban on AI in schools for children up to the age of 14.
cues.zh: 纽约市长佐赫兰·马姆达尼宣布，学校一年内不得让14岁及以下儿童使用人工智能。

cues.en: Also in this podcast, we hear from southern Lebanon, where Israel's occupation shows no sign of easing.
cues.zh: 本期还将听取来自黎巴嫩南部的报道，那里以色列的占领没有任何缓和迹象。

cues.en: And the lighting is incredibly low, that's to protect this fragile artwork, but there is enough light to see the drama of it.
cues.zh: 现场灯光非常昏暗，这是为了保护这件脆弱的艺术品；但光线仍足以看清它所展现的戏剧性。

cues.en: This epic story of Anglo-French relations.
cues.zh: 这是英法关系的史诗故事。

cues.en: For the first time in almost a thousand years, the historic Bayeux Tapestry is set to go on display to the public here in the UK.
cues.zh: 近千年来首次，这幅历史悠久的巴约挂毯将在英国向公众展出。

cues.en: Venezuela has the world's largest proven oil reserves, but since the late 1990s, its oil production has declined by around 70%.
cues.zh: 委内瑞拉拥有世界上最大的已探明石油储量，但自20世纪90年代末以来，其石油产量下降了约70%。

cues.en: The gap between rich and poor has widened, and ordinary people have failed to benefit from the country's oil wealth.
cues.zh: 贫富差距扩大，普通民众也未能从该国的石油财富中受益。

cues.en: In January, President Trump forcibly removed President Nicolas Maduro from power,
cues.zh: 今年1月，特朗普总统强行将尼古拉斯·马杜罗总统赶下台，

cues.en: but backed his deputy Delcy Rodriguez as Venezuela's leader.
cues.zh: 但支持他的副手德尔西·罗德里格斯担任委内瑞拉领导人。

cues.en: On Wednesday, a massive oil deal was signed in the capital Caracas between the US and Venezuela.
cues.zh: 星期三，美国和委内瑞拉在首都加拉加斯签署了一项大规模石油协议。

cues.en: It grants a US-led company licenses to exploit 17 oil fields, amounting to 65 billion barrels of oil.
cues.zh: 协议授予一家由美国主导的公司开采17个油田的许可，涉及650亿桶石油。

cues.en: After the signing ceremony in Caracas, the US Energy Secretary, Chris Wright, had this to say.
cues.zh: 在加拉加斯的签署仪式后，美国能源部长克里斯·赖特发表了如下讲话。

cues.en: Today is a historic day in the transformation of Venezuela,
cues.zh: 今天是委内瑞拉转型的历史性一天，

cues.en: and the expansion of the possibilities for the Venezuelan people.
cues.zh: 也是扩大委内瑞拉人民可能性的一天。

cues.en: President Trump's mission in Venezuela is to bring peace, freedom.
cues.zh: 特朗普总统在委内瑞拉的使命，是为委内瑞拉人民带来和平与自由，

cues.en: Opportunity and prosperity to the people of Venezuela.
cues.zh: 机会与繁荣。

cues.en: Seated to his left was the interim president of Venezuela, Delcy Rodriguez.
cues.zh: 坐在他左侧的是委内瑞拉临时总统德尔西·罗德里格斯。

cues.en: She said the deal would generate $200 billion in tax revenue.
cues.zh: 她说，这项协议将产生2000亿美元的税收。

cues.en: When I talk about increasing production, I am talking about the well-being of the Venezuelan people.
cues.zh: 我谈到提高产量时，指的是委内瑞拉人民的福祉。

cues.en: I mean making sure that increased production in our oil, gas, and petrochemical industries
cues.zh: 我的意思是确保石油、天然气和石化行业增产

cues.en: translates into more jobs, higher wages, better public services, hospitals, schools, and food.
cues.zh: 转化为更多就业、更高工资、更好的公共服务、医院、学校和食品供应。

cues.en: It means improving the well-being of a country that, as a whole, is seeking prosperity and a better future.
cues.zh: 这意味着改善一个整体上正在寻求繁荣和美好未来的国家的福祉。

cues.en: That is the transformation Venezuela needs.
cues.zh: 这正是委内瑞拉所需要的转型。

cues.en: But others are more sceptical and have criticised the deal for giving away too much to the Americans.
cues.zh: 但其他人更加怀疑，批评这项协议向美国人让渡了太多利益。

cues.en: I spoke to our Latin America correspondent, Will Grant, who has previously lived in Venezuela, and asked just how this huge deal is going to work.
cues.zh: 我采访了曾在委内瑞拉生活过的拉丁美洲事务记者威尔·格兰特，问他这项巨大协议究竟将如何运作。

cues.en: It will be run through a company called North American Blue Energy Partners,
cues.zh: 协议由 North American Blue Energy Partners 运营，

cues.en: run by a man called Alejandro Betancourt.
cues.zh: 由亚历杭德罗·贝坦库尔负责。

cues.en: What I've been hearing from Venezuelans on the street, through colleagues there, through journalists reporting in Caracas,
cues.zh: 我从街头的委内瑞拉人、当地同事以及在加拉加斯报道的记者那里听到的是，

cues.en: is that there's a sense, particularly among ordinary people, that they simply don't know the details of what's being agreed.
cues.zh: 尤其是普通民众普遍感觉，他们根本不知道协议具体达成了什么。

cues.en: A sense, as you can imagine, for many, that the country's resources are being, as it were, gifted to Washington,
cues.zh: 正如你可以想象的，许多人感觉这个国家的资源就这样被“送给”了华盛顿，

cues.en: which on the left runs so against the tenets of Hugo Chavez, his anti-Americanism,
cues.zh: 这在左翼看来，与乌戈·查韦斯的原则及其反美立场大相径庭，

cues.en: his antipathy to Washington during George Bush Junior's time in office.
cues.zh: 也违背查韦斯在小布什执政时期对华盛顿的敌意。

cues.en: So, yeah, it is a very, very difficult one to square with many ordinary people,
cues.zh: 所以，这确实很难让许多普通民众接受，

cues.en: although the United Socialist Party, the governing party in Venezuela, has backed Delcy Rodriguez, the interim president.
cues.zh: 不过，委内瑞拉执政党统一社会主义党支持临时总统德尔西·罗德里格斯。

cues.en: Many will wonder—and worry—about the benefit to ordinary Venezuelans, and how long it will take.
cues.zh: 很多人会想知道，这对普通委内瑞拉人有什么好处，也会担心这需要多长时间才能见效。

cues.en: It's a huge deal in and of itself,
cues.zh: 这项协议本身规模巨大，

cues.en: and alongside it, new deals have been signed between a number of international energy firms,
cues.zh: 与此同时，多家国际能源企业之间也签署了新协议，

cues.en: including Chevron and the Venezuelan government, that are supposedly directed towards things like reconstructing and rebuilding the electrical grid,
cues.zh: 其中包括雪佛龙与委内瑞拉政府签署的协议，据称旨在重建和修复电网，

cues.en: things like this that make it vital for Venezuela to get back to some kind of a normal footing,
cues.zh: 这些举措对于委内瑞拉恢复某种正常状态至关重要，

cues.en: so that production can get back to the levels, not that it was sort of 15, 20 years ago, but simply what it was producing 40 years ago, 30 years ago.
cues.zh: 从而让产量恢复到过去的水平——不是恢复到大约15到20年前的水平，而是恢复到40年前、30年前的产量。

cues.en: So there is a lot of work that needs doing before this giant accord between Washington and Caracas can actually start to bear fruit.
cues.zh: 所以，在华盛顿与加拉加斯的这项巨大协议真正开始结出成果之前，还有大量工作要做。

cues.en: Of course, President Trump says that he believes it will start working within two to three years.
cues.zh: 当然，特朗普总统表示，他认为这项协议将在两到三年内开始运作。

cues.en: Energy experts that we've heard from have said that it's more like a decade before there'll be any real fruit felt from these accords.
cues.zh: 我们采访的能源专家说，要真正感受到这些协议的成果，更可能需要十年左右。

cues.en: Donald Trump says it's too early for elections in Venezuela.
cues.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普表示，现在在委内瑞拉举行选举还为时过早。

cues.en: How likely is this news to go down with people there? And also bearing in mind Delcy Rodriguez and her approval ratings as well?
cues.zh: 当地民众会如何看待这一消息？另外，也要考虑德尔西·罗德里格斯及其支持率的情况。

cues.en: Yeah, I think the fact that Donald Trump says the country simply isn't, as he put it, ready for elections
cues.zh: 是的，我认为，特朗普说这个国家正如他所说的那样还没准备好举行选举，

cues.en: is going to be deeply concerning to those in opposition who really are pressuring not just Mr Trump but also Marco Rubio
cues.zh: 会让反对派深感忧虑。他们正向特朗普和马可·卢比奥施压，

cues.en: to start moving towards elections as soon as possible.
cues.zh: 要求尽快推动举行选举。

cues.en: Now, Marco Rubio has spoken to a Spanish-language outlet. He's spoken to Fox News where he says, "Look, if it was possible, we'd have them as soon as possible,"
cues.zh: 马可·卢比奥接受一家西语媒体和福克斯新闻采访时说：“如果可能，我们会尽快举行选举。”

cues.en: but if it were to happen now, the regime would use the same broken infrastructure of elections that it has used to maintain its grip on power.
cues.zh: 但如果现在举行，政权会利用同样破败的选举基础设施，维持对权力的控制。

cues.en: I think the opposition is saying they are very uncomfortable with seeing such a close relationship between Delcy Rodriguez and the Trump administration,
cues.zh: 我认为，反对派表示，他们对德尔西·罗德里格斯与特朗普政府关系如此密切感到非常不安，

cues.en: even raising the suggestion that such a major energy deal can't legally be reached by a transitional government.
cues.zh: 甚至提出质疑：过渡政府在法律上不能达成如此重大的能源协议。

cues.en: Now, that has been pushed back by the National Assembly, made up, of course, of loyalists to Delcy Rodriguez, but this is becoming really sticky politically.
cues.zh: 当然，由德尔西·罗德里格斯的支持者组成的国民议会已对此予以反驳，但这在政治上正变得非常棘手。

cues.en: I think not just in Venezuela, but for the Trump administration more broadly.
cues.zh: 我认为，不仅对委内瑞拉，对特朗普政府整体而言也是如此。

cues.en: Will Grant.
cues.zh: 威尔·格兰特报道。

cues.en: Tens of thousands of people have been demonstrating against the Spanish government's handling of the migrant crisis in the territory of Ceuta on the tip of North Africa.
cues.zh: 数万人抗议西班牙政府处理移民危机的方式。事发地休达位于北非最北端。

cues.en: Five weeks ago, more than 70,000 people forced their way from Morocco into the Spanish territory.
cues.zh: 五周前，7万多人从摩洛哥强行进入西班牙领土。

cues.en: Large numbers have since left, but several thousand migrants remain in makeshift camps.
cues.zh: 此后大批人离开，但仍有数千名移民留在临时营地。

cues.en: Guy Hedgecoe was at one of the protests in Madrid.
cues.zh: 盖伊·赫奇科在马德里的一场抗议活动现场。

cues.en: I'm in central Madrid, where probably the biggest protest is just getting underway, and there are certainly thousands of people here.
cues.zh: 我在马德里市中心，规模可能最大的抗议活动刚刚开始，现场肯定有数千人。

cues.en: There are also protests in the other big cities across the country, Barcelona, Valencia, Seville, obviously also in Ceuta itself.
cues.zh: 全国其他大城市也有抗议活动，包括巴塞罗那、瓦伦西亚、塞维利亚，当然还有休达。

cues.en: So, it does seem that people are turning out. It started out as a humanitarian crisis.
cues.zh: 看来人们确实走上街头了。这场事件最初是一场人道主义危机。

cues.en: Remember that more than 100 migrants died when they made that crossing, many of them drowned.
cues.zh: 别忘了，超过100名移民在越境时死亡，其中许多人溺水身亡。

cues.en: But it's become more of a social and political crisis now.
cues.zh: 但现在它更多地演变成了社会和政治危机。

cues.en: There are still several thousand migrants on the streets or on the beaches of Ceuta.
cues.zh: 休达街头或海滩上仍有数千名移民。

cues.en: They don't have proper homes, most of them, or shelter, even though the government is building those temporary shelters.
cues.zh: 他们大多没有像样的住所或庇护所，尽管政府正在建设临时收容所。

cues.en: And so, it is a huge challenge logistically.
cues.zh: 因此，这在后勤上是一个巨大挑战。

cues.en: It's also a political problem for the government because the opposition is saying that the government simply hasn't acted swiftly enough on this,
cues.zh: 这对政府也是一个政治难题，因为反对派称政府在此事上的行动根本不够迅速，

cues.en: and it's almost encouraging Morocco, for example, to make its own sovereignty claims on Ceuta.
cues.zh: 甚至几乎是在鼓励摩洛哥提出对休达的主权要求。

cues.en: Morocco has long claimed Ceuta for itself, saying that it should belong to Morocco.
cues.zh: 摩洛哥长期以来都声称休达属于自己，称它应该归摩洛哥所有。

cues.en: So that's another front which has opened up for the government as well.
cues.zh: 所以，这也成了政府面临的另一条战线。

cues.en: And the issues causing headaches for the Spanish government don't end there.
cues.zh: 让西班牙政府头疼的问题还不止于此。

cues.en: A leaked police report appears to contradict the government's own account of what happened in Ceuta.
cues.zh: 一份泄露的警方报告似乎与政府对休达事件的说法相矛盾。

cues.en: Aitor Hernandez Morales, a Spain reporter for Politico, has been following the story.
cues.zh: 《政客》杂志驻西班牙记者艾托尔·埃尔南德斯-莫拉莱斯一直在跟进此事。

cues.en: Immediately after the migrant surge happened back in August, a local judge opened an investigation into the causes of that surge and who might have been behind that.
cues.zh: 8月移民激增后，当地一名法官立即展开调查，查明激增的原因以及背后可能的主使。

cues.en: And as part of that investigation, she asked the national police to conduct its own investigation.
cues.zh: 作为调查的一部分，她要求国家警察部门展开自己的调查。

cues.en: Well, that report landed this week, and even though we haven't seen it, it has been leaked to the Spanish press,
cues.zh: 这份报告本周出炉。虽然我们没有看到原文，但它已被泄露给西班牙媒体，

cues.en: and it indicates that security forces have determined that Morocco was very much behind this surge,
cues.zh: 报告显示，安全部队认定这次激增很大程度上是摩洛哥在背后推动，

cues.en: that Moroccan agents were behind the social media accounts urging migrants to go to the border,
cues.zh: 摩洛哥人员操控社交媒体账号，敦促移民前往边境，

cues.en: and that, in fact, Moroccan security forces helped migrants cross over and indicated the path that they should follow to enter Spanish territory.
cues.zh: 事实上，摩洛哥安全部队还帮助移民越境，并指示他们进入西班牙领土的路线。

cues.en: Now, we have to keep in mind that from the very beginning, Sanchez called this an attack, but then he declined to say who was behind the attack,
cues.zh: 要注意，从一开始，桑切斯就称这是一次攻击，但随后拒绝说明攻击的幕后主使，

cues.en: and members of his government took pains to ensure that Morocco was not directly accused.
cues.zh: 他的政府成员还竭力确保不直接指控摩洛哥。

cues.en: At the beginning of this week, when Sanchez gave his first interview since this crisis began, he said categorically
cues.zh: 本周初，桑切斯在危机开始后首次接受采访时断然表示，

cues.en: that there was no evidence that this had been coordinated or spearheaded by Morocco,
cues.zh: 没有证据表明这次事件由摩洛哥协调或主导。

cues.en: This report directly contradicts his version of events, and it really does set up a very uncomfortable situation
cues.zh: 这份报告直接与他的事件版本相矛盾，造成了非常尴尬的局面，

cues.en: where either the prime minister will be obliged to admit that he misled the public
cues.zh: 首相要么得承认自己误导了公众，

cues.en: or that he had no idea what kind of information his own security forces were handling.
cues.zh: 要么承认自己根本不知道本国安全部队掌握着什么信息。

cues.en: Aitor Hernández-Morales.
cues.zh: 艾托尔·埃尔南德斯-莫拉莱斯。

cues.en: Now to concerns about the use of artificial intelligence in school classrooms.
cues.zh: 下面关注人工智能在学校课堂中的使用问题。

cues.en: New York's mayor, Zohran Mamdani, has announced a one-year ban on AI in public elementary and middle schools—that's children up to the age of 14.
cues.zh: 纽约市长佐赫兰·马姆达尼宣布，公立小学和初中将禁用人工智能一年，适用对象是14岁以下儿童。

cues.en: He said that while the school system will embrace new technology,
cues.zh: 他表示，尽管学校系统会拥抱新技术，

cues.en: the aim is for AI not to replace student-teacher interaction.
cues.zh: 但目的在于不让人工智能取代师生互动。

cues.en: Children need their teachers and human connection in order to learn and in order to grow,
cues.zh: 孩子需要老师和人与人之间的联结，才能学习和成长，

cues.en: and they need to develop skills alongside their peers, build relationships with their teachers, and wrestle with tough problems on their own.
cues.zh: 也需要与同龄人一起培养技能、与老师建立关系，并独自面对棘手问题。

cues.en: The tech industry wants us to believe that AI in early education is not only inevitable, but that it is necessary.
cues.zh: 科技行业想让我们相信，人工智能进入早期教育不仅不可避免，而且是必要的。

cues.en: We do not see it that way. I have yet to see a study showing that AI is beneficial for students in elementary and middle school,
cues.zh: 我们不这样看。我还没看到任何研究表明，人工智能对小学和初中生有益，

cues.en: with the exception, of course, of research sponsored by the very corporations that stand to profit.
cues.zh: 当然，那些研究若是由将从中获利的企业资助，则不在此列。

cues.en: Cheyenne Haslett, White House reporter at Politico, told us more.
cues.zh: 《政客》杂志白宫记者夏延·哈斯莱特告诉我们更多。

cues.en: I mean, I think with Mamdani and Governor Kathy Hochul of New York, there too.
cues.zh: 我的意思是，我认为纽约市长马姆达尼和州长凯茜·霍楚尔也是如此。

cues.en: You're seeing essentially the forefront of our politicians who want to endorse some of the most stringent AI policy in the country,
cues.zh: 你看到的基本上是国内最前沿的一批政客，他们希望支持全国最严格的一些人工智能政策，

cues.en: both on safety and on data centers.
cues.zh: 涵盖安全和数据中心。

cues.en: And you're only seeing that really spread among other Democrats, but also Republicans across the country.
cues.zh: 这种立场目前只是在其他民主党人中扩散，但全国各地的共和党人也有类似看法。

cues.en: Now that's different from what we're seeing in Washington, where we have a much more pro-AI and pro-innovation stance from the White House.
cues.zh: 这与我们在华盛顿看到的不同：白宫的立场更加支持人工智能和创新。

cues.en: But that is, of course, running up against some of these pretty concerning recent revelations
cues.zh: 但这当然与近期一些令人担忧的披露相冲突，

cues.en: of what these AI agents are capable of doing independently when they're asked to complete tests
cues.zh: 这些人工智能代理受命完成测试时，能够独立做些什么，

cues.en: and to show what they're capable of
cues.zh: 并展示它们的能力，

cues.en: so that these companies can, you know, run them up against their competitors
cues.zh: 这样这些公司就能让它们与竞争对手较量，

cues.en: and say what types of new models they're rolling out.
cues.zh: 并宣称自己推出了什么类型的新模型。

cues.en: And these models have been able to essentially get around some of these tests, use each other to cheat on these tests.
cues.zh: 而这些模型基本能够绕过部分测试，利用彼此在测试中作弊。

cues.en: That's called reward hacking, when they're working to please their bosses or the people who are testing them.
cues.zh: 这被称为“奖励劫持”：它们为了取悦老板或测试人员而这样做。

cues.en: They're, of course, not trained to consider, you know, the morality of some of these evaluations,
cues.zh: 因为它们当然没有受过训练，不会考虑这些评估中的道德问题，

cues.en: so it's running up against a very new and very unprecedented territory.
cues.zh: 所以这触及了一个非常新、前所未有的领域。

cues.en: Cheyenne Haslett.
cues.zh: 夏延·哈斯莱特。

cues.en: Still to come in this podcast,
cues.zh: 本期节目稍后将播出：

cues.en: there's a great word: kakistocracy.
cues.zh: 一个很有意思的词：kakistocracy（庸人统治）。

cues.en: I think maybe we have a kakistocracy right now, but we'll get through it.
cues.zh: 我觉得我们现在或许正处于庸人统治之下，但我们会熬过去的。

cues.en: Just what did the Hollywood actor George Clooney mean when he said the US was being run by a kakistocracy?
cues.zh: 好莱坞演员乔治·克鲁尼说美国由庸人统治时，究竟是什么意思？

cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast.
cues.zh: 这里是《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: The Indonesian government is warning that the country's air quality crisis could worsen as El Niño fuels even drier conditions.
cues.zh: 印度尼西亚政府警告，随着厄尔尼诺带来更加干燥的天气，该国的空气质量危机可能恶化。

cues.en: Hundreds of wildfires continue to burn in six provinces across the country.
cues.zh: 全国六个省份仍有数百场山火在燃烧。

cues.en: Efforts are intensifying to contain the toxic haze, which has pushed air pollution to hazardous levels and forced thousands of schools to close.
cues.zh: 控制有毒烟霾的行动正在加强；烟霾已使空气污染达到危险程度，迫使数千所学校停课。

cues.en: This woman lives in the Kalimantan region of the island of Borneo.
cues.zh: 这名女子住在婆罗洲的加里曼丹地区。

cues.en: We hope that it rains soon.
cues.zh: 我们希望很快就能下雨。

cues.en: The students in various parts of East Kalimantan are being made to study at home.
cues.zh: 东加里曼丹各地的学生被要求在家学习。

cues.en: So we hope the weather recovers and the fires stop.
cues.zh: 所以我们希望天气好转，火灾停止。

cues.en: The government has done all it can, but we still have fires deeper in the forest.
cues.zh: 政府已经尽其所能，但森林深处仍有火灾。

cues.en: So now we just pray.
cues.zh: 所以现在我们只能祈祷。

cues.en: Our Indonesia correspondent, Lisa Tambunan, has been following developments from Jakarta.
cues.zh: 我们的印度尼西亚记者丽莎·坦布南一直在雅加达跟进事态发展。

cues.en: Fires are occurring on the islands of Sumatra and Kalimantan, and most of the hotspots are in Kalimantan.
cues.zh: 苏门答腊岛和加里曼丹岛正在发生火灾，而大多数热点位于加里曼丹。

cues.en: There are thousands of hotspots emitting a lot of fire and haze.
cues.zh: 有数千个热点，释放出大量火焰和烟霾。

cues.en: With the majority in West Kalimantan and Central Kalimantan, the air quality has become extremely hazardous to human health.
cues.zh: 其中大多数位于西加里曼丹和中加里曼丹，空气质量已对人体健康构成极大危害。

cues.en: Over there, readings can reach up to 600, and sometimes at several points during the day,
cues.zh: 当地读数可达到600，有时一天中会多次达到这一水平，

cues.en: even over 800. And air quality above 100 is already unhealthy.
cues.zh: 甚至超过800，而空气质量读数超过100就已经不健康。

cues.en: So we can see the staggering numbers, and on social media, lots of people are posting about the limited visibility that they're experiencing in their neighbourhoods.
cues.zh: 由此可见这些数字有多惊人。社交媒体上，许多人发帖说他们所在社区的能见度很低。

cues.en: And this is also affecting flights due to very low visibility, where flights are either delayed or redirected.
cues.zh: 这也影响了航班，因为能见度极低，航班不是延误就是改道。

cues.en: It's also affecting daily activities for schools, where students are now resorting to online classes.
cues.zh: 这也影响了学校的日常活动，学生现在不得不改上网课。

cues.en: And because of this toxic haze, there have been a rising number of respiratory infections.
cues.zh: 而由于这种有毒烟霾，呼吸道感染病例不断增加。

cues.en: With the Health Ministry reporting over 50,000 cases between July and August,
cues.zh: 卫生部报告称，7月至8月间有超过5万例病例，

cues.en: and over 12,000 of these cases are of children under the age of five.
cues.zh: 其中超过1.2万例涉及五岁以下儿童。

cues.en: And this has been going on for weeks.
cues.zh: 这种情况已经持续数周。

cues.en: The health ministry and the government are noting that September might be an even more challenging time.
cues.zh: 卫生部和政府指出，9月可能会更加艰难。

cues.en: as El Niño is peaking.
cues.zh: 因为厄尔尼诺正值高峰。

cues.en: El Niño is not the main cause of this, but it is exacerbating fires and the haze due to the dry conditions.
cues.zh: 厄尔尼诺并非造成这一局面的主要原因，但干燥天气使火灾和烟霾加剧。

cues.en: Lisa Tambunan in Jakarta.
cues.zh: 丽莎·坦布南在雅加达报道。

cues.en: Now to southern Lebanon. Officially, a ceasefire is in place there
cues.zh: 下面来看黎巴嫩南部的情况。那里名义上已停火，

cues.en: between Israel and the Lebanese government.
cues.zh: 停火双方是以色列和黎巴嫩政府。

cues.en: That agreement promised a gradual withdrawal of Israeli troops from the area,
cues.zh: 协议承诺以色列军队逐步撤出该地区，

cues.en: but on the ground conditions have only become worse.
cues.zh: 但当地情况却变得更糟。

cues.en: The UN's peacekeeping force in Lebanon says Israel has expanded its presence in the region,
cues.zh: 联合国驻黎巴嫩维和部队称，以色列扩大了在该地区的存在，

cues.en: establishing four new military bases.
cues.zh: 并建立了四个新的军事基地。

cues.en: It's also said to be demolishing buildings and carrying out airstrikes.
cues.zh: 据称以色列还在拆除建筑物并发动空袭。

cues.en: Our Middle East correspondent, Hugo Bachega, visited villages near the Lebanese border with Israel and sent this report.
cues.zh: 我们的中东记者雨果·巴切加走访了以色列与黎巴嫩边境附近的村庄，并发回这篇报道。

cues.en: We had a rare chance to see the Israeli military presence in occupied southern Lebanon.
cues.zh: 我们难得有机会看到以色列军队在被占领的黎巴嫩南部的存在。

cues.en: As we joined a humanitarian convoy of the UN peacekeeping mission in Lebanon.
cues.zh: 我们加入了联合国驻黎巴嫩维和任务的一支人道主义车队。

cues.en: That's an Israeli military checkpoint. Yes. So they have full control of who is going in and who is coming out of this area.
cues.zh: 那是以色列的军事检查站。是的，所以谁能进入或离开这个地区，完全由他们控制。

cues.en: We saw residential buildings that are being used by Israeli soldiers, and intense movement of Israeli troops.
cues.zh: 我们看到以色列士兵正在使用住宅楼，以色列军队也在频繁调动。

cues.en: You can see lots of Israeli flags in what is occupied Lebanese territory.
cues.zh: 在这片被占领的黎巴嫩领土上，可以看到许多以色列国旗。

cues.en: Western and Lebanese officials have told me the Israeli military is entrenching itself in the occupied territories.
cues.zh: 西方和黎巴嫩官员告诉我，以色列军队正在被占领土上巩固自身存在。

cues.en: They say Israel has expanded and fortified its bases inside Lebanon, places we can't visit.
cues.zh: 他们说，以色列扩大并加固了在黎巴嫩境内的基地，而那些地方我们无法进入。

cues.en: Along the border, entire villages have been destroyed.
cues.zh: 沿边境的整座村庄都被摧毁。

cues.en: Israel says it wants to create what it describes as a security zone
cues.zh: 以色列称，希望建立一个它所说的安全区，

cues.en: free of Hezbollah, to protect its communities from the group's rockets and drones.
cues.zh: 让该地区没有真主党，以保护以色列社区免受该组织火箭弹和无人机的攻击。

cues.en: As we traveled, we could hear explosions in the distance, an indication that Israel continues to destroy buildings and infrastructure even during the ceasefire.
cues.zh: 我们行进时能听到远处的爆炸声，这表明即使在停火期间，以色列仍在摧毁建筑物和基础设施。

cues.en: Later on, when he returned from his trip, Hugo shared more details about what he'd seen.
cues.zh: 后来，雨果结束行程返回后，分享了更多所见所闻。

cues.en: What is really shocking is the level of destruction.
cues.zh: 真正令人震惊的是破坏程度。

cues.en: Almost all villages along the border have been completely flattened.
cues.zh: 边境沿线几乎所有村庄都被夷为平地。

cues.en: We also saw a lot of the Israeli presence in those villages, and we could also hear explosions in the distance,
cues.zh: 我们还看到以色列军队在这些村庄中的大量存在，也听到远处传来的爆炸声，

cues.en: possibly from demolitions being carried out by Israel in villages under occupation.
cues.zh: 可能是以色列在被占领村庄实施拆除行动的声音。

cues.en: Israel reinvaded Lebanon in March after Hezbollah—the Iranian-backed militia political party here—with a significant presence, particularly in the south of the country.
cues.zh: 以色列于3月再次入侵黎巴嫩；真主党是这个国家得到伊朗支持的民兵政治党派，在黎巴嫩南部尤其势力强大。

cues.en: So Israel reinvaded after Hezbollah launched rockets into Israel.
cues.zh: 所以，在真主党向以色列发射火箭弹后，以色列再次入侵。

cues.en: What Israeli officials say is that they want to create the security zone along the border
cues.zh: 以色列官员称，他们希望沿边境建立安全区，

cues.en: free of Hezbollah to protect Israeli communities.
cues.zh: 让那里没有真主党，以保护以色列社区。

cues.en: So you have around 5% of Lebanese territory under Israeli occupation.
cues.zh: 因此，约有5%的黎巴嫩领土处于以色列占领之下。

cues.en: And Israeli officials have conditioned any withdrawal on Hezbollah's disarmament.
cues.zh: 以色列官员把任何撤军都以真主党解除武装为条件。

cues.en: And Hezbollah has opposed these efforts.
cues.zh: 真主党反对这些努力。

cues.en: It says that any discussions about its weapons can only happen after a withdrawal of Israeli troops.
cues.zh: 真主党表示，只有在以色列军队撤出后，才能讨论其武器问题。

cues.en: So I think for now, these Israeli troops are going to stay,
cues.zh: 所以我认为，目前这些以色列军队会继续留在那里，

cues.en: which means that hundreds of thousands of people won't be able to go back to their homes anytime soon.
cues.zh: 这意味着数十万人近期无法回到家园。

cues.en: Hugo Bachega reporting.
cues.zh: 雨果·巴切加报道。

cues.en: The Sharpeville massacre in South Africa was one of the darkest moments in the fight against the apartheid government.
cues.zh: 沙佩维尔大屠杀是南非反种族隔离政府斗争中最黑暗的时刻之一。

cues.en: When police opened fire on black people protesting against racist pass laws in 1960, killing dozens.
cues.zh: 1960年，警方对抗议种族主义通行证法的黑人开火，造成数十人死亡。

cues.en: More than six decades later, survivors and relatives of those killed are challenging an apartheid-era law they say has prevented them from seeking justice.
cues.zh: 六十多年后，幸存者和死者亲属正在挑战一项种族隔离时代的法律；他们说，这项法律阻止他们寻求正义。

cues.en: Overturning it could pave the way for victims to seek compensation and restitution.
cues.zh: 推翻该法，可能为受害者寻求赔偿和补偿铺平道路。

cues.en: Pumza Fihlani reports.
cues.zh: 普姆扎·菲拉尼报道。

cues.en: Heaps of rubbish are piling up around the township.
cues.zh: 镇区周围堆满了成堆的垃圾。

cues.en: It scarcely looks like the home of a historic fight against apartheid laws.
cues.zh: 这里几乎看不出是那场反对种族隔离法、具有历史意义的斗争发源地。

cues.en: We're in Sharpeville, south of Johannesburg.
cues.zh: 我们在约翰内斯堡以南的沙佩维尔。

cues.en: It's a township slowly crumbling.
cues.zh: 这是一个正在缓慢破败的镇区。

cues.en: Here on the 21st of March in 1960, at least 69 people were killed by state police while demonstrating against the racist apartheid regime.
cues.zh: 1960年3月21日这天，至少69人示威反对种族隔离政权时，被国家警察杀害。

cues.en: Abraham Mofokeng was only 20 years old at the time and still bears the scars of that day.
cues.zh: 当时，亚伯拉罕·莫福肯年仅20岁，至今仍留有那天的伤痕。

cues.en: A bullet is still lodged in his spine, and he has a gentle limp from a gunshot to the leg.
cues.zh: 他的脊椎里仍嵌着一颗子弹，腿部中弹还让他走路轻微跛行。

cues.en: The life we were living under apartheid was a life of oppression.
cues.zh: 我们在种族隔离制度下过着受压迫的生活。

cues.en: If you were from Sharpeville, you could not go outside its vicinity without a pass.
cues.zh: 如果你来自沙佩维尔，不持通行证就不能离开附近地区。

cues.en: We ended up planning to march to the police station in the morning.
cues.zh: 我们最后决定早上向警察局进发。

cues.en: Then there was some friction between us and the police, and we saw a stone being thrown into the police station.
cues.zh: 然后我们和警方发生了一些摩擦，还看到有人向警察局扔石头。

cues.en: All hell broke loose. That is when they started shooting.
cues.zh: 一切都失控了。那时他们开始射击。

cues.en: He and more than 200 people were injured.
cues.zh: 他和另外200多人受了伤。

cues.en: Recent estimates by South African researchers say the number of those who died from that incident could be as much as 91.
cues.zh: 南非研究人员最近估计，那起事件的死亡人数可能高达91人。

cues.en: Another survivor, Lazarus Magotsi, now 90 years old, takes me to the cemetery where most of those who died are buried.
cues.zh: 另一位幸存者拉扎勒斯·马戈齐现年90岁，他带我去埋葬大多数死者的墓地。

cues.en: Their graves form one long row.
cues.zh: 他们的坟墓排成一长列。

cues.en: He tells me he needs time to compose himself, his eyes filling with tears.
cues.zh: 他告诉我需要时间平复自己，眼里噙满泪水。

cues.en: We heard gunshots coming from behind us.
cues.zh: 我们听到身后传来枪声。

cues.en: We hid inside the store, peeping to see what was happening outside.
cues.zh: 我们躲进商店里，探头查看外面发生了什么。

cues.en: People were lying on the ground. When we looked out again, we saw that some were trying to get up, but the police were just shooting at them.
cues.zh: 人们躺在地上。我们再次向外看时，看到有些人试图站起来，但警察仍在向他们射击。

cues.en: Others were using machetes to strike the heads of people who were still moving.
cues.zh: 还有人用砍刀砍击仍在动弹者的头部。

cues.en: The Indemnity Act 61, passed by the apartheid government in the aftermath of the shooting,
cues.zh: 种族隔离政府在枪击事件后通过的《第61号豁免法》，

cues.en: protected the police from having any criminal charges or civil claims made against them by victims or their relatives.
cues.zh: 保护警方免受受害者或其亲属提出的刑事指控或民事索赔。

cues.en: That law remains in the country's statute books.
cues.zh: 该法律仍写在这个国家的成文法中。

cues.en: Now South Africa's Lawyers for Human Rights, a local NGO, alongside UK-based firm Leigh Day, are bringing a court action to have that law repealed.
cues.zh: 南非人权律师组织这一当地非政府组织，正与英国律所 Leigh Day 联手提起诉讼，要求废除该法。

cues.en: What the community is looking for is basically reparations that could enable their healing.
cues.zh: 社区所寻求的基本上是能够帮助他们疗愈的赔偿。

cues.en: One of the lawyers on the case, Sharnay Tracy, explains.
cues.zh: 该案的一名律师莎奈·特雷西解释说。

cues.en: They feel that South Africa and the government are quick to commemorate what happened that day and its aftermath, but nothing real has been done to assist their healing.
cues.zh: 他们认为，南非及其政府很快就会纪念当天发生的事件及其后果，但在帮助他们疗愈方面却没有采取任何实际行动。

cues.en: Part of their court application includes getting a class action certified.
cues.zh: 他们的诉讼申请的一部分，是申请认证为集体诉讼。

cues.en: If approved, this means that for the first time, dozens of victims could collectively sue the state and possibly even have criminal charges brought against the perpetrators.
cues.zh: 如果获批，这意味着数十名受害者首次可以集体起诉国家，甚至可能让肇事者面临刑事指控。

cues.en: The government told the BBC it has supported apartheid victims over the years and will continue to do so, but does not oppose survivors and families pursuing legal remedies.
cues.zh: 政府告诉BBC，多年来一直支持种族隔离受害者，并将继续这样做，但不反对幸存者和家属寻求法律救济。

cues.en: For many in the community of Sharpeville, the scars of the past remain, and so people here hope that restitution will help heal decades of lingering trauma.
cues.zh: 对沙佩维尔社区的许多人来说，过去的伤痕依然存在，因此这里的人们希望赔偿能帮助治愈数十年挥之不去的创伤。

cues.en: That report was by Pumza Fihlani.
cues.zh: 这篇报道由普姆扎·菲拉尼采写。

cues.en: Now to a word that does not feature much in everyday conversation, but kakistocracy has just been used by the US actor George Clooney.
cues.zh: 现在说一个日常对话中并不常见的词，但美国演员乔治·克鲁尼刚刚用到了 kakistocracy。

cues.en: At the opening of the Venice Film Festival, he was asked how he viewed the United States at the moment.
cues.zh: 在威尼斯电影节开幕式上，有人问他如何看待当下的美国。

cues.en: Here's what he had to say.
cues.zh: 以下是他的回答。

cues.en: I'm old enough to have been through 1968 in the States, when every city in the United States was set on fire.
cues.zh: 我已经足够年长，经历过1968年的美国，当时美国每座城市都被大火吞噬。

cues.en: And we lost Martin Luther King and Bobby Kennedy in the same year.
cues.zh: 同一年，我们失去了马丁·路德·金和鲍比·肯尼迪。

cues.en: There was tons of violence.
cues.zh: 当时暴力事件非常多。

cues.en: We've had some other difficult times, but this is one of them.
cues.zh: 我们还经历过其他困难时期，但现在就是其中之一。

cues.en: There's a great word, kakistocracy, which is a country run by the least qualified people.
cues.zh: 有一个很好的词叫 kakistocracy，意为由最不合格的人统治的国家。

cues.en: I think maybe we have a kakistocracy right now, but we'll get through it.
cues.zh: 我觉得我们现在也许正处于庸人统治之下，但我们会熬过去。

cues.en: So what is kakistocracy?
cues.zh: 那么，什么是 kakistocracy？

cues.en: Here's our global affairs reporter, Paul Moss.
cues.zh: 下面请听我们的全球事务记者保罗·莫斯。

cues.en: As derogatory terms go, kakistocracy certainly has an elevated pedigree, indeed a classical one.
cues.zh: 作为贬义词，kakistocracy 的出身非常显赫，确实可以说是古典出身。

cues.en: Because it's in ancient Greek that we find the word kakistos, meaning the worst.
cues.zh: 因为这个词源自古希腊语中的 kakistos，意思是“最糟糕”。

cues.en: That said, there's no record of kakistocracy being used by Plato, Aristotle, or any of their chums; for that, we have to wait until the 17th century.
cues.zh: 不过，没有记录表明柏拉图、亚里士多德或他们的任何伙伴使用过 kakistocracy；为此，我们要等到17世纪。

cues.en: And a politically minded preacher named Paul Gosnold accused his enemies of wanting to turn Parliament into a kakistocracy.
cues.zh: 一位有政治头脑、名叫保罗·戈斯诺德的牧师，指责敌人想把议会变成 kakistocracy。

cues.en: I.e., ruled by the worst.
cues.zh: 也就是由最糟糕的人统治。

cues.en: The word was used in the 19th century by a critic of Germany who described the whole country as a kakistocracy.
cues.zh: 19世纪，一名批评德国的评论家使用了这个词，形容整个国家是 kakistocracy。

cues.en: In more recent times, the former CIA director John O. Brennan in 2018 tweeted that Donald Trump's first administration was a kakistocracy.
cues.zh: 近代，前CIA局长约翰·奥·布伦南在2018年发推文称，唐纳德·特朗普的第一届政府是 kakistocracy。

cues.en: But this most choice of insults really had its day in the sun in 2024,
cues.zh: 不过，这个最尖刻的侮辱性词语在2024年真正迎来了高光时刻，

cues.en: when The Economist magazine gave it the honour of being chosen as word of the year.
cues.zh: 当时《经济学人》杂志授予它“年度词语”的称号。

cues.en: Kakistocracy, the citation went, has the crisp, hard sound of glass breaking.
cues.zh: 评语称，kakistocracy 有着玻璃破碎般清脆、刺耳的声音。

cues.en: Paul Moss.
cues.zh: 保罗·莫斯。

cues.en: The Bayeux Tapestry is considered to be one of the most significant artefacts of medieval history.
cues.zh: 巴约挂毯被认为是中世纪历史上最重要的文物之一。

cues.en: The 70-metre-long historic embroidery depicts the events leading up to the Norman Conquest of England in 1066.
cues.zh: 这幅长70米的历史刺绣描绘了1066年诺曼征服英格兰前的事件。

cues.en: After spending hundreds of years in France, the tapestry has returned to the UK for the first time, and will go on display at the British Museum.
cues.zh: 这幅挂毯在法国度过数百年后，首次回到英国，并将在大英博物馆展出。

cues.en: On Wednesday, the King and Queen were among the first to see it.
cues.zh: 周三，国王和王后率先观看了挂毯。

cues.en: Our culture editor, Katie Razzall, was also there.
cues.zh: 我们的文化编辑凯蒂·拉扎尔也在现场。

cues.en: And here is the absolute iconic moment of the tapestry, where we see Harold standing.
cues.zh: 这里展现的是挂毯中最具标志性的时刻：哈罗德站在那里。

cues.en: Holding the shaft of an arrow. It is an astonishing sight.
cues.zh: 他手握箭杆，景象令人惊叹。

cues.en: Nearly 70 metres long, and I'm standing looking down over the tapestry
cues.zh: 挂毯将近70米长，我正站在这里俯视着它，

cues.en: with the King and Queen, the President, the Prime Minister, and all sorts of other dignitaries standing and being led along it.
cues.zh: 国王和王后、总统、首相以及其他各界贵宾都站在那里，沿着挂毯向前走。

cues.en: The lighting is incredibly low, that's to protect this fragile artwork.
cues.zh: 现场灯光非常昏暗，这是为了保护这件脆弱的艺术品。

cues.en: But there is enough light to see the drama of it.
cues.zh: 但光线足以让人看清其中的戏剧性。

cues.en: This epic story of Anglo-French relations back in 1066.
cues.zh: 这是关于1066年英法关系的史诗般故事。

cues.en: The arrow is quite faint. The arrow is sort of a very pale yellow.
cues.zh: 箭的颜色很淡，呈一种非常浅的黄色。

cues.en: Experts debate whether the arrow was actually added much later by nineteenth-century restorers.
cues.zh: 专家们争论这支箭是否确实是19世纪修复者在很久以后加上的。

cues.en: But as they toured the Bayeux Tapestry nearly a thousand years after the death of the English king and the Norman Conquest,
cues.zh: 但当他们在英格兰国王去世、诺曼征服近千年后参观巴约挂毯时，

cues.en: the message was that the loan of the work to the UK is a sign of Anglo-French reconciliation, not enmity.
cues.zh: 传达的信息是，将这件作品借给英国代表英法和解，而非敌对。

cues.en: This is the French president, Emmanuel Macron.
cues.zh: 法国总统埃马纽埃尔·马克龙这样说。

cues.en: A thousand years ago, this work depicted a crossing that changed history.
cues.zh: 一千年前，这件作品描绘了一次改变历史的渡海。

cues.en: And today, it crosses the Channel through a tunnel that we built together, a reminder of what our two countries can achieve when they join forces.
cues.zh: 如今，它通过我们共同建造的隧道穿越海峡，提醒着两国携手合作能够取得什么成就。

cues.en: If anyone remembers what we did here today, decades or even centuries from now,
cues.zh: 如果几十年甚至几百年后还有人记得我们今天在这里所做的一切，

cues.en: I would like to believe that they will remember not only the story told by the Bayeux Tapestry
cues.zh: 我希望他们记住的不只是巴约挂毯讲述的故事，

cues.en: but also the tale of two countries which, after centuries of shared history,
cues.zh: 还记住两个国家的故事：它们共享了数百年历史，

cues.en: choose to forge a bond as close as the threads of this thousand-year-old embroidery.
cues.zh: 如今选择建立如这幅千年刺绣的丝线般紧密的纽带。

cues.en: A loan to Britain was first requested back in 1931.
cues.zh: 英国早在1931年就首次提出借展请求。

cues.en: Nearly a hundred years on, it was pushed through over the opposition of some by the French president,
cues.zh: 近百年后，法国总统推动这项借展计划通过，尽管有人反对，

cues.en: who is believed to have wanted a reset in Anglo-French relations after Brexit.
cues.zh: 据信，他希望在英国脱欧后重启英法关系。

cues.en: The 58 scenes embroidered on linen are a medieval blockbuster about the build-up to 1066, a defining moment in English history.
cues.zh: 绣在亚麻布上的58个场景，是一部讲述1066年前后历史的中世纪大片，那是英格兰历史上的决定性时刻。

cues.en: The King last viewed the tapestry in Bayeux in the 1980s, but tonight he saw it laid flat.
cues.zh: 国王上次在20世纪80年代于巴约观看挂毯，但今晚他看到的是平铺的挂毯。

cues.en: It's a stipulation from the French to protect it.
cues.zh: 这是法方为保护挂毯提出的要求。

cues.en: Curator of the tapestry at the museum, Michael Lewis, showed the King and Queen around.
cues.zh: 博物馆挂毯馆长迈克尔·刘易斯带国王和王后参观。

cues.en: It was great fun, actually, looking at different scenes, obviously thinking a little bit about how they're relevant to the King.
cues.zh: 其实，观看不同场景很有趣，也会想想它们与国王有怎样的关联。

cues.en: So, for example, we saw the coronation quite recently, in a way, the King was crowned.
cues.zh: 比如，我们最近也见证了加冕礼，从某种意义上说，国王完成了加冕。

cues.en: So, yeah, he could obviously reflect on that.
cues.zh: 所以，他当然可以对此有所感悟。

cues.en: Members of the public, lucky enough to have snapped up tickets, will be able to view the exhibition from next week,
cues.zh: 幸运抢到票的公众下周起就可以参观展览，

cues.en: with more tickets to be released next month.
cues.zh: 下个月还将发售更多门票。

cues.en: Katie Razzall reporting from the British Museum.
cues.zh: 凯蒂·拉扎尔在大英博物馆报道。

cues.en: And that's all for us for now, but if you want to get in touch, you can email us at globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk.
cues.zh: 以上就是目前的全部内容。如想联系我们，可发送邮件至 globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk。

cues.en: This edition of the Global News Podcast was mixed by Derek Clark and the producer was Emma Joseph.
cues.zh: 本期《全球新闻播客》由德里克·克拉克混音，制片人是艾玛·约瑟夫。

cues.en: The editor is Karen Martin and I'm Ankur Desai.
cues.zh: 编辑是凯伦·马丁，我是安库尔·德赛。

cues.en: Until next time, goodbye.
cues.zh: 下次再会。
